name: Aisai Ingyaku Auction ~ Shakkin Hensai ni Aterarete...
original_name: 愛妻淫虐オークション～借金返済に充てられて…
source:
Housewife Miki was on her usual routine one afternoon, 
walking through the neighborhood to buy an afternoon lunch, 
when black-clad men sudden forced her into a vehicle. 
The ride was long, and in her terror she eventually lost consciousness.

Miki's husband had racked up huge debts with bad men. Miki was collateral.
She was being sold to the highest bidder, and the bidders were horny. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE065528.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
某天下午，家庭主妇美纪像往常一样走在附近的街道上，准备去买午餐，却突然被几个黑衣男子强行塞进车里。
车开了很久，惊恐万分的她最终失去了意识。

美纪的丈夫欠了恶人一大笔债，而美纪就是抵押品。
她将被卖给出价最高的人，那些竞买者个个欲火中烧。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE065528.html]DLsite English[/url]]
